standard_prerequisites.name: Transitivity (cut) of derivability
standard_prerequisites.use: Line 957: the final collapse Gamma |- falsum from the two lifted derivations.

core_obligations: Lift (proof lines 952-956): inconsistency of Gamma + {A} means Gamma + {A} |- falsum; reflexivity gives Gamma + {A} |- B for each B in Gamma (trivially) and the hypothesis supplies Gamma + {A} |- A - written as: every member of the extended set is derivable from it since Gamma |- A holds by hypothesis.
Cut (line 957): transitivity applied to Gamma |- A and {A} + Gamma |- falsum yields Gamma |- falsum, the definition of inconsistency.
proof_roadmap: Read the extended set's derivations off the hypothesis.
Apply the cut proposition to pull falsum back to Gamma.
difficulty_reason: One of the three inconsistency-transfer laws used by the completeness construction (statement 947-950, proof 952-959): fully written in seven lines, every step tagged with the same-part proposition it borrows. H2: two-lemma application with both citations explicit.
